steps.title: Cell Resuscitation and Initial Culture
steps.instruction: Resuscitate cryopreserved cells and establish initial culture.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 6 ml of culture solution in a centrifuge tube within a clean bench.
Thaw the cryotube in a 37°C water bath for 1 min.
Transfer melted cell fluid into the centrifuge tube containing 6 ml culture solution.
Centrifuge at 2000 r/min for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells by flicking the tube by hand and adding 10 ml of culture solution.
Dispense the medium equally into 2 small flasks (5 ml per vial).
Observe cell state under a microscope and culture in an incubator.

steps.title: Cell Passaging
steps.instruction: Passage adherent cells to maintain culture.

substeps.instruction: Discard old medium and wash once with 1 ml PBS; discard PBS.
Add 1 ml trypsin-EDTA digest, shake evenly, and incubate for 1 min until cells round up (observe via inverted microscope).
Stop digestion by adding culture solution; gently detach cells from the wall using 3 ml culture solution.
Centrifuge at 2000 r/min for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Dispense the cell-containing medium into 2 small flasks.
Move cells from incubator to clean bench, shake flask side-to-side, and pour off waste liquid containing dead cells.
Wash twice with 3 ml PBS and discard waste.
Perform trypsin digestion (1 ml) for 2-3 min; observe rounding under inverted microscope.
Terminate digestion with 4 ml culture solution and pipette to create a uniformly dispersed suspension.
Centrifuge at 2000 r/min for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet in cryopreservation solution (culture solution containing 10% DMSO) and aliquot 1 ml into each cryotube.
Place cryotubes in a programmed cooling box at -80°C overnight, then transfer to liquid nitrogen tank the next day.

steps.title: Primary Cardiomyocyte Isolation from SD Rats
steps.instruction: Isolate cardiomyocytes from neonatal SD rat hearts.

substeps.instruction: Prepare five 10 cm2 culture dishes: two with 75% alcohol and autoclaved PBS, and three with complete culture medium.
Sterilize SD rats in a petri dish with alcohol; excise hearts using autoclaved scissors and place in PBS.
Squeeze out residual blood using straight and curved sputum; transfer heart to complete culture solution and squeeze out blood three more times.
Cut heart tissue into small pieces with scissors, place in a centrifuge tube, allow fragments to deposit, and discard supernatant.
Add culture solution to a 50 ml centrifuge tube on ice.
Add trypsin to tissue and digest for ~40 s; after standing for a few minutes, aspirate supernatant into the 50 ml tube on ice. Repeat until heart is completely digested.
Filter the medium through a 200 mesh filter cloth into a 15 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at room temperature for 5 min at 2000 r/min and discard supernatant.
Mix cells with complete medium, transfer to a culture flask, and incubate.
After 1.5 to 2 hours, aspirate the upper layer (containing cardiomyocytes) and place in another culture flask, leaving adhered fibroblasts behind.
Plate cells in a six-well plate and culture for 24 hours in antibiotic-free culture solution.
Prepare Tube A: Opti-MEM and plasmid. Prepare Tube B: Opti-MEM and Lipo-2000. Centrifuge briefly to sink liquid; leave at room temperature for 5 min.
Mix Tube A and Tube B and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.
Wash the plate twice with empty culture solution.
Add the mixture to the six-well plate, shake using an 8-fold method, and incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 24 h.
Change the solution 4-6 hours after transfection.

steps.title: Viral Infection
steps.instruction: Infect cells with a virus stock.

substeps.instruction: Perform a pre-experiment to determine the optimal virus amount for normal fluorescence and minimal cell damage.
Inoculate cells into a 24-well plate the day before infection to achieve 60%-70% density on the second day.
Dilute virus stock solution in medium and add directly to the 24-well plate.
After 24 hours, replace with serum-containing medium and culture under normal conditions.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence Staining
steps.instruction: Fix and stain cells for fluorescence microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Treat cells with 4% paraformaldehyde for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash three times for 5 min each with PBS.
Treat with 0.1% Triton X-100 in TBS for 20 min at room temperature (RT).
Wash three times for 5 min each with PBS.
Block with goat serum for 30 min at RT.
Wash three times for 5 min each with PBS, then three times for 5 min each with PBST (repeated twice).
Add fluorescence quenching agent, seal, and image via fluorescence microscope.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for flow cytometry analysis.

substeps.instruction: Digest cells, transfer to 1.5 ml EP tube, and centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 5 min.
Discard supernatant, resuspend in PBS, and centrifuge again at 2000 rpm for 5 min.
Add 1 ml of probe (diluted with PBS) and incubate for 30 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge at 2000 rpm, discard supernatant, add 1 ml PBS, resuspend, and centrifuge; repeat this wash twice.
Resuspend cells in 500 ul PBS and transfer to flow tube, avoiding light.

steps.title: Electron Microscopy Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Fix and prepare cells for EM observation.

substeps.instruction: Fix with 2.5% glutaraldehyde at 4°C for 1-3 h.
Dehydrate using a gradient alcohol series (30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, 100%), passing each concentration twice for 3-5 min each.
Dry with acetonitrile followed by vacuum drying.
Coat with carbon and gold spray.
Plate cells in a 96-well plate at 100 ul/well (>2000 cells/well), with 200 ul PBS in surrounding wells to prevent evaporation.
When cells reach 90% confluence, add 10 ul CCK-8 solution to each well.
Incubate in a 96-well plate storage incubator for 1-2 h.
Measure absorbance at 450 nm using a microplate reader and calculate proliferation rate.

steps.title: Protein Extraction and Western Blot
steps.instruction: Extract proteins and perform Western Blot analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place culture dish on ice and wash with ice-cold PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add ice-cold lysis buffer (1 mL per 10^7 cells/100 mm dish/150 cm2 flask; 0.5 mL per 5x10^6 cells/60 mm dish/75 cm2 flask).
Scrape adherent cells with a cold plastic scraper and transfer to a pre-cooled microcentrifuge tube (or trypsinize and wash with PBS first).
Centrifuge at 4°C for 15 min at 13500 rpm.
Aspirate supernatant into a fresh ice-cooled tube and discard the pellet.
Measure protein concentration using a BCA protein assay.
Boil lysate in sample buffer at 100°C for 7 min.
Load 60 μg of total protein and molecular weight markers into an SDS-PAGE gel.
Run at 80V for ~30 min, then increase to 120V once samples enter the stacking gel.
Activate PVDF membrane with methanol for 1 min and rinse with transfer buffer.
Assemble gel-membrane sandwich, place in buffer tank with pre-cooled transfer buffer, and transfer at 200V for 80 minutes.
Block the membrane for 1 h at room temperature.
Incubate with primary antibody in blocking buffer overnight at 4°C.
Wash three times with TBST for 5 min each.
Incubate with conjugated secondary antibody in blocking buffer at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash three times with TBST for 5 min each.
